Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend** holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, or is observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|--------------------------|---------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | ✔ | The holiday is observed on Monday, giving a 4‑day break (Sat Jan 1–Mon Jan 2). |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat Feb 18–Mon Feb 20). |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri Apr 7–Sun Apr 9). |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat May 20–Mon May 22). |
| 5 | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Ontario only) | Friday Mar 17 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri Mar 17–Sun Mar 19). |
| 6 | **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | ✔ | Observed on Monday, giving a 4‑day break (Sat Jul 1–Mon Jul 3). |
| 7 | **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat Sep 2–Mon Sep 4). |
| 8 | **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat Oct 7–Mon Oct 9). |
| 9 | **Remembrance Day** | Monday Nov 11 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat Nov 9–Mon Nov 11). |
|10 | **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | — | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat Dec 23–Mon Dec 25). |
|11 | **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | ✘ | Falls on a Tuesday; no long weekend. |

### Quick‑links & APIs

| Resource | What it offers | How to use |
|----------|----------------|------------|
| **Canada.ca – Public Holidays** | Official list of federal holidays (incl. dates & observances) | https://www.canada.ca/en/services/finance/tax/holiday.html |
| **Nager.Date – Public Holidays API** | JSON feed of public holidays by country & year | https://date.nager.at/api/v2/PublicHolidays/2023/CA |
| **Canadian Federal Holidays CSV** | Downloadable CSV of all federal holidays (2010‑2030) | https://github.com/datasets/canadian-federal-holidays |

### How to integrate into your app

1. **Static list** – If you only need 2023 data, copy the table above into your database or config file.  
2. **Dynamic API** – Call the Nager.Date endpoint (`GET https://date.nager.at/api/v2/PublicHolidays/2023/CA`) and filter for `type === "Public"` and `date` that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on a Monday).  
3. **Localisation** – Remember that some holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day) are province‑specific. If your app supports multiple provinces, add a `province` field to each holiday record and filter accordingly.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown (e.g., province‑by‑province lists, CSV export, or code snippets for a particular language). Happy planning!
